p4Transcribe.summary: Transcribes an existing PCM clip locally and waits for the speech worker.
p4Transcribe.returns: Recognized text; check speech status for unavailable profile or failed request.
prerequisites: Import P4 Local Speech and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use transcribe audio … language …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Transcribes an existing PCM clip locally and waits for the speech worker. Recognized text; check speech status for unavailable profile or failed request. First save the result of record PCM for [1000] milliseconds as clip; check audio valid and release it when finished.

notes: Local Whistle transcription of an immutable 16000 Hz mono PCM handle, 0.1 to 4 seconds. Requires the separately built model profile. English=0, German=1, French=2, Spanish=3, Italian=4, Dutch=5, Polish=6, auto=-1. Worker is bounded and Stop cancels it. This does not start a microphone or a wake-word listener.
Source: boards\waveshare_esp32p4_wifi6\integration\P4_Speech.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
